LanguageData.DMSL_Weapon_AutomatroidHeavyMachineGun.d: A vehicle-mounted heavy machine gun fitted with a carry handle. Large-caliber rounds provide strong penetration.
LanguageData.DMSL_Weapon_AutomatroidHeavyShotgun.desc: A large-caliber shotgun usable only by mechanoids or power-armored personnel. Can fire stun rounds.
LanguageData.DMSL_Weapon_CompetitiveRifle.label: Competitive Rifle
LanguageData.DMSL_Weapon_CompetitiveRifle.description: A competitive rifle that switches between semi-auto and full-auto. An ideal choice for full-auto beginners.
LanguageData.DMSL_Bullet_40mm.label: 81mm High-Explosive Shell
LanguageData.DMSL_Weapon_AutomatroidAssaultRifle.desc: An automatroid assault rifle with an underbarrel grenade launcher.
LanguageData.DMSL_Weapon_Lance.label: Knight's Lance
LanguageData.DMSL_Weapon_Lance.description: A cavalry lance designed for Scouts. Damage increases with movement speed.\n\n"Past a certain speed threshold, the lance becomes unstoppable."
LanguageData.DMSL_Weapon_IED.label: IED
LanguageData.DMSL_Weapon_IED.description: As you can see, this is a remote-detonated bomb. Up to four can be deployed at once.
LanguageData.DMSL_Bullet_2HuntingRifle.label: Hunting Rifle Round
LanguageData.DMSL_Weapon_HuntingRifle.label: Hunting Rifle
LanguageData.DMSL_Weapon_HuntingRifle.description: An old military marksman rifle. No longer active on the battlefield, it gradually became a well-regarded hunting weapon after entering civilian use.
